project.name: Snowboard Prep PWA
project.description: Mobile-optimized progressive web app for the Snowboard Prep workout routine with timers, rep counters, and vector illustrations for each activity

tasks.title: Setup PWA project structure
tasks.description: Initialize a modern PWA project with Vite/React, configure manifest.json, service worker, and create basic folder structure (components, assets, utils, styles)
criteria: Service worker setup for offline capability
Folder structure created (src/components, src/assets, src/utils, src/styles, public)
Basic routing setup for activity screens

tasks.title: Create workout data model
tasks.description: Structure the workout data from the PDF into JSON format with all activities, their types (timed/reps/sets), durations, and descriptions
criteria: workoutData.json created with all 4 sections (Warm-up, Mobility & Stretching, Strength & Stability, Optional Recovery)
Each activity has: id, name, type (timer/reps/sets), duration/count, side (if applicable), description
Data includes section metadata (total duration, order)

tasks.title: Design and implement overall timer component
tasks.description: Create a persistent overall workout timer that appears at the top of every screen, tracks total elapsed time, and can be paused/resumed
criteria: Timer displays in MM:SS format at top of all screens
Timer state managed globally (Context or Zustand)

tasks.title: Build activity timer component
tasks.description: Create a timer component for timed activities with large start button, countdown display, and sound effect when timer expires
criteria: Countdown displays in large, easy-to-read font
Sound effect plays when timer reaches 0
Visual indication when timer expires (flash/color change)

tasks.title: Build rep counter component
tasks.description: Create a component for exercises with reps/sets showing large numbers and a NEXT button to advance
criteria: Large, prominent display of current rep/set count
For 'each side' exercises, tracks left/right separately
Visual feedback when set is completed

tasks.title: Create activity screen template
tasks.description: Build a reusable screen template that displays activity name, illustration, appropriate control (timer/rep counter), and next button
criteria: Conditionally renders timer OR rep counter based on activity type
NEXT button to advance to next activity
Mobile-optimized layout (full screen, no scrolling needed)

tasks.title: Implement workout navigation and state
tasks.description: Create navigation logic to move between activities, track progress, and handle workout completion
criteria: Can skip or go back to activities
State persists if app is closed (localStorage)

tasks.title: Create home/start screen
tasks.description: Build a landing screen with workout overview, start button, and option to view weekly structure
criteria: Quick access to jump to specific section

tasks.title: Add sound effects
tasks.description: Integrate sound effects for timer completion and other interactions, with user preference to enable/disable
criteria: Audio files are optimized (small file size)

tasks.title: Design vector illustrations - Warm-up activities
tasks.description: Create simple, clean vector illustrations for: Marching/jumping jacks, hip circles, ankle circles, torso rotations

tasks.title: Design vector illustrations - Mobility & Stretching
tasks.description: Create vector illustrations for: World's Greatest Stretch, Figure-4 stretch, hamstring hip-hinge, calf stretch, ankle dorsiflexion, cat-cow
criteria: Shows proper form for each stretch
Clear visual cues for movement direction where applicable

tasks.title: Design vector illustrations - Strength & Stability
tasks.description: Create vector illustrations for: single-leg balance, single-leg Romanian deadlift, split squats, glute bridges, dead bug, side plank

tasks.title: Design vector illustrations - Recovery
tasks.description: Create vector illustrations for: deep squat hold, gentle spinal twist

tasks.title: Integrate all illustrations into app
tasks.description: Import all vector illustrations and connect them to their respective activities in the app
criteria: Fallback UI if image fails to load

tasks.title: Style and optimize for mobile
tasks.description: Apply mobile-first responsive design, ensure touch targets are large enough, optimize for one-handed use during workout
criteria: Layout works on screens from 320px to 428px width
Font sizes are readable during exercise (min 18px for body)
Works in both portrait and landscape

tasks.title: Add settings and preferences
tasks.description: Create a settings screen for sound preferences, timer settings, and other customization options
criteria: Option to adjust timer buffer times

tasks.title: Implement offline functionality
tasks.description: Ensure the PWA works completely offline with service worker caching all assets
criteria: Service worker caches all HTML, CSS, JS
App works with no internet connection

tasks.title: PWA install and icons
tasks.description: Configure PWA installation prompts, create app icons, and ensure Add to Home Screen works smoothly
criteria: Install prompt works on iOS Safari
Install prompt works on Android Chrome

tasks.title: Testing on mobile devices
tasks.description: Test the app on real iOS and Android devices, fix any device-specific issues

tasks.title: Deploy and configure hosting
tasks.description: Deploy the PWA to a hosting service (Vercel, Netlify, etc.) with HTTPS and proper PWA headers
